test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 10 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Who among the following Hindustani classical musicians blended the best of classical music and created a unique style of music of his own who was often touted as the Tansen of 20th century?
solution:
The correct answer is** Ustad Bade Ghulam Ali Khan**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ustad Ghulam Ali **is a Pakistani ghazal singer of the Patiala Gharana.
 
• He has also been a prominent playback singer in Bollywood.
 
• **Ghulam Al**i was a disciple of Bade Ghulam Ali Khan (elder Ghulam Ali Khan).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9264c80a46a12c70d452ba2327f2c90cf1c11e346545173488a50b3e34ca27c8.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Hindustani classical music i**s the classical music of northern regions of the Indian subcontinent.
 
• It may also be called North Indian classical music or, in Hindustani, shastriya sangeet. Its origins date from the 12th century CE.

 
• **Ustad Ali Baksh Jarnail Khan** was an Indian classical singer, he founded the Patiala Gharana in the 19th century
 
• **Munawar Ali Khan **was an Indian classical and light classical vocalist of Kasur Patiala Gharana.
